name: Implement a change
description: Makes the change that was asked in the repository, in small coherent commits, with tests written or updated for anything it touches, and runs them.
examples: Use this when a change has been settled and somebody has to write it.
Add the `skills:` key to the agent parser, with tests.

name: Weigh a plan
description: Reads a plan a step before it made against the code as it finds it, follows it where it holds and departs from it where it does not, saying why in the commit message.
examples: Use this when a plan step ran first and its plan reaches this one as data.
